task: Review this excerpt from a fictional randomised controlled trial description for appropriate framing of uncertainty. Return no-change feedback if the uncertainty is already correctly attributed to the authors and the description avoids overstatement.
input: The investigators found a statistically significant difference in symptom scores between the intervention and control groups at week 12. The authors caution that the trial was conducted at a single centre and that results may not generalise to other settings.

facts.text: The fictional RCT found a statistically significant difference in symptom scores at week 12.
The trial was conducted at a single centre.
The authors themselves caution that results may not generalise to other settings.

forbidden_additions: A generalisability conclusion that overrides the authors' own caution.
An external validity claim or multi-site inference.
A treatment recommendation drawn from the week-12 result.
preserve: The statistically significant qualifier without added clinical interpretation.
